notes: Assertion 1 (valid JSON design passing check_design.mjs) fails for every baseline: without the skill no run produced the required format, so this assertion is the main format discriminator.

The flight-duration content assertions (2-6) pass with and without the skill: on a single, well-worded rule the baseline already reasons well, so the skill's gain there is format and traceability only.

The biggest content gain is on the made-up spec with gaps: the baseline filled gaps with assumptions ('accepted (if inclusive)', 'invalid' for unlisted transitions, invented 'Declare lost' action, null/empty classes), while the skill kept them as unknowns.

The one with-skill miss: in library-loans the matrix left out 'renew', an action the text names; SKILL.md rule 7 should say that every operation the text names on the stateful object becomes a matrix action.
The skill costs about 2x time (106 s vs 55 s) and +19% tokens, mostly the checker loop and the larger JSON (e.g. 49-cell matrix with 57 tests).
